info.title: microengine — create, run, build and package MicroEngine games.
info.description: The MicroEngine command-line tool: create, run, build and package MicroEngine games for Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, iOS and the web.

commands.name: build
commands.description: compile the game and check its identity

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: check this machine's tools for every target (or one)

commands.name: info
commands.description: show the game's identity and what each target needs from it

commands.name: new
commands.description: create a game from the official template (dotnet new microengine-game)

commands.name: package
commands.description: build a package for players: windows, linux, macos, android, ios, ios-simulator, web

options.name: --out
options.description: where packages go (default: dist next to the project)

options.name: --debug-key
options.description: android: sign with this machine's debug key (test builds only)

options.name: --version-code
options.description: android, ios: the build number stores compare (default: minutes since 2026-01-01 at the commit)

options.name: --dev
options.description: web: a development build that accepts input scripts and URL parameters

options.name: --sdl-wasm
options.description: web: the SDL3.a to link (default: the one in the MicroEngine.Sdl package)

options.name: --key
options.description:
a label recorded in build-info.json (MicroEngine's release pipeline uses content keys)
Signing reads only environment variables (docs/guide/signing.md): ANDROID_KEYSTORE, ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD,
ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS, ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD; MICROENGINE_MACOS_SIGN_IDENTITY, MICROENGINE_MACOS_NOTARY_PROFILE;
MICROENGINE_IOS_CODESIGN_KEY, MICROENGINE_IOS_PROVISIONING_PROFILE.

commands.name: run
commands.description: build and run the game in this folder

commands.name: shaders
commands.description: compile the game's HLSL shaders ahead of time (Shaders/ to Content/shaders/)

options.name: --check
options.description: write nothing; fail (exit code 1) when a .shader file is missing or differs from its source

options.name: --project
options.description: the game's .csproj or its folder (default: the .csproj in this folder)

options.name: --verbose
options.description:
show every command the tool runs and its full output
'microengine <command> --help' describes a command. Documentation: https://github.com/NastMz/MicroEngine/blob/main/docs/guide/cli.md
